title: The Mark of Twin Destinies
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji's fingers were about to touch that mysterious existence, the corpse that had slumbered for ten thousand years in the coffin suddenly opened its eyes, and a surge of Heavenly Secrets aura, of the same origin as the Tianji Record, gushed forth like a tide—

text.content: Just as Chen Ji fell into deliberation, the first page of the Tianji Record suddenly burned hot, and the familiar voice of Mo Xiansheng, the remnant soul guardian, rang out again—though carrying an urgency never seen before. 'Go! Something awaits you on the second level!' Mo Xiansheng's voice seemed torn by some force, fragmentary and broken. 'That is... something you must witness... with your own eyes...' Before the words finished, an irresistible pulling force surged from the depths of the ruins, dragging Chen Ji entire into that black fissure.

In the world spinning before his eyes, Chen Ji felt his body pass through a barrier soft as water. When he opened his eyes again, the scene before him stole his breath—a vast underground stone chamber, its walls carved with obscure inscriptions, and in the center stood two jade coffins side by side. Upon them lay two figures, surrounded by a faint Spiritual Light. The one on the left had a peaceful expression—it was Chen Xuan, whom Chen Ji had seen in the illusion!

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently) 'You see... the twin destines... Chen Xuan and that other one... they were originally one, yet Heavenly Fate cruelly tore them apart!'

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed his shock and turned his gaze to the coffin on the right. Inside lay a young man about his age, with handsome features but an air of sinister energy, and on his Brow Center was an imprint identical to the cover of the Tianji Record. His chest rose and fell slightly, as if still breathing! Chen Ji's pupils constricted—he would never mistake this aura.

The Tianji Record flipped open on its own, golden light blazing, pages rustling. Chen Ji looked down to see a blurry image gradually emerging on what had been a blank second page—a young man standing before countless armies, clearly the commander of the Demonic Path forces! The image showed him tearing open the sky with a single hand, gazing over the world with contempt, perfectly matching the figure sleeping in the coffin.

Chen Ji felt an unprecedented chill. He recalled what Mo Xiansheng had once said—the Tianji Record chose Chen Xuan, yet abandoned another. Could this abandoned one be the predecessor of the Demonic Path commander before him? The cruel irony of Heavenly Fate lay in making two beings who should have been as one walk entirely different paths—one becoming a leader of justice, the other a villain of the Demonic Path.

dialogue.content: 'Chen Xuan carries the Tianji Record's power of 'Foresight,' and the other... carries the power of 'Tampering,' said Mo Xiansheng's voice, imbued with endless vicissitudes. 'They should have joined hands to change the world, yet Heavenly Fate set them against each other—one righteous, one evil, their destinies opposed for ten thousand years!'

text.content: Chen Ji walked slowly toward that coffin, each step as heavy as a mountain. He wanted to reach out and touch that mysterious existence's face, but his fingertips halted in mid-air—the Tianji Record was shaking frantically at this moment, as if issuing some warning. He narrowed his eyes, his mind racing. If these two were truly twin bodies of one soul, did his inheritance of the Tianji Record's legacy imply a destined opposition from the very beginning?

choice.prompt: The mysterious being's chest continued to rise and fall slightly, as if still alive. Chen Ji needed to make a decision—

choices.text: Risk touching to initiate Heavenly Secrets Resonance
choices.description: Attempt to use your own Tianji Record's aura to create resonance with this mysterious existence, perhaps to glimpse more truths, but the risk is unknown.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key memory fragments regarding the origin of Twin Destinies
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record emits intense warnings; unknown backlash may occur

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and placed his palm on the coffin. The Tianji Record suddenly blazed with golden light, and a familiar yet strange power surged through his Meridian—instantly, countless images flashed through his mind like a carousel: the destiny of two infants torn apart at birth, the Heaven-manipulated confrontation of righteousness and evil, and those chilling words—'I am the Eye of Heavenly Fate, you are all merely Chess Pieces!'

choices.text: Step back and observe, gather more information
choices.description: Do not act rashly; first observe whether there are any formation traps around this mysterious existence. Mo Xiansheng may still know more.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain additional background information revealed by Mo Xiansheng
choices.risk_hint: May miss the opportunity for first contact

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his palm, stepped back two paces, and said coldly: 'Mo Xiansheng, just how much else have you hidden from me?' Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment, then finally sighed: 'This matter involves far too much—I shouldn't have told you now... But since you've come this far—that other one is a 'Dark Piece' deliberately planted by the Eye of Heavenly Fate. Its sole purpose is to oppose the Tianji Record's bearer until one side is completely annihilated!'

text.content: Chen Ji's lips curved into a cold smile as he drew a silver needle from his sleeve—the Awakening Needle he had obtained from the system, specifically designed to break illusionary barriers. Without hesitation, he thrust the needle into the mysterious existence's Brow Center mark. In that instant, the youth's tightly closed eyes trembled slightly, and a low murmur escaped his lips: '...Brother... you've finally... arrived...'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Brother? Who is he calling? Chen Xuan had perished ten thousand years ago, yet this mysterious existence clearly appeared to be of similar age. Could it be—a terrifying thought exploded in his mind. Had the Tianji Record chosen him as the inheritor not by coincidence, but as some kind of fateful continuation? Could there also be some connection between him and Chen Xuan that transcended time?

Just as Chen Ji fell into a storm of thoughts, the youth in the coffin suddenly stiffened. The Brow Center mark blazed with piercing black light, and a force originating from yet diametrically opposite to the Tianji Record swept forth like a monstrous wave. The inscriptions on the stone chamber walls began flickering frantically, and dense cracks spread across the floor, as if something was about to break free from its seal!

dialogue.content: A withered yet authoritative voice thundered in Chen Ji's mind: 'Another chess piece, presuming to pry into heavenly secrets?' The voice was ice-cold and utterly devoid of emotion, like Heaven itself passing judgment. 'Chen Xuan's inheritor... or perhaps I should say, a new vessel. Will the drama of destined twins play out once more through you?'

text.content: Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure envelop his entire body. The pages of the Tianji Record rustled loudly, as if resisting something. He gritted his teeth, veins bulging at his temples—this was the first time since crossing into this world that he had so clearly perceived the existence of the 'Eyes of Heaven'. That oppressive force was almost material, pressing down on him until he could barely breathe, yet it also ignited an unprecedented fighting spirit within his heart.

choice.prompt: The Will Projection of the Eyes of Heaven is watching you. Faced with this transcendent existence, Chen Ji chooses—

choices.text: Strike back directly, using Heavenly Secrets to contend against Heaven
choices.description: Activate the full power of the Tianji Record, confronting this Will Projection head-on, proving through action that he is no chess piece to be manipulated.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 10 points of Heavenly Fate, may trigger Heaven's backlash
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the title 'Heaven Defier', causing the Eyes of Heaven to retreat temporarily
choices.risk_hint: The disparity in strength is immense, may suffer severe injuries

text.content: Chen Ji threw his head back and laughed wildly, his laughter echoing through the stone chamber: 'A chess piece? Eyes of Heaven, you flatter yourself!' He bit his tongue without hesitation, spraying a mouthful of essence blood onto the Tianji Record. The golden pages instantly transformed into a blinding pillar of light, shooting directly toward that Will Projection. Amidst the deafening roar, the withered authoritative voice let out a startled 'hm', and then the oppressive pressure receded like a tide.

choices.text: Retreat to advance, endure in silence
choices.description: Do not engage directly; preserve strength first, use words to probe this Will's bottom line, secretly arrange future counterattacks.
choices.visible_cost: No consumption required, but must endure part of the oppressive pressure
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial clues regarding the weaknesses of the Eyes of Heaven
choices.risk_hint: Intentions may be seen through by the Eyes of Heaven

text.content: Chen Ji restrained his smile and bowed respectfully, his posture impeccable in its deference: 'Junior Chen Ji greets the senior. Since you claim to embody Heaven, surely you would not deign to lay hands on this ant of a junior—I wonder what brings the senior forth to instruct me?' The Will fell silent for a moment, then suddenly burst into a meaningful laugh: 'Interesting... more adept at patience than Chen Xuan. But remember this—on the chessboard, there are no true victors.'

text.content: Just as Chen Ji believed everything had settled, the youth in the coffin suddenly opened his eyes. They were pupils as black as ink, yet now radiated golden light identical to the Tianji Record. The two beams of light converged in mid-air, and Chen Ji felt an explosion in his mind as countless unfamiliar memories flooded in like a tide—he saw a newborn infant brutally divided in two at birth, witnessed two youths being manipulated by Heaven toward opposition, and most chillingly, saw a truth that froze his entire body:

Those two infants—one was Chen Xuan's predecessor, while the other was竟然 identical in appearance to himself, Chen Ji! So he had not transmigrated to another world, but had been reincarnated by Heaven as the other half of 'Destined Twins' into another timeline, now returning once more! This meant he and Chen Xuan were originally one entity; the Tianji Record's choice of him was not coincidence, but destiny!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised his head and let out a laugh bordering on madness: 'What a Heaven! What a chess game! So from the very beginning, I was goddamn just a piece on the board!' His laughter echoed through the stone chamber, filled with desolation and fury. A堂堂 transmigrator, a strategist who calculated without error—yet in the end, merely a character in Heaven's woven drama of destiny!

text.content: The youth in the coffin slowly sat up, and a complex smile appeared on that face so identical to Chen Ji's. He looked at Chen Ji, his voice hoarse and weary: 'Brother... or perhaps I should call you my other self. We were torn apart by Heaven for ten thousand years, and now finally reunited. But do you know why Heaven wants us to meet at this moment?' His eyes flickered with a hint of cunning, 'Because... the chess game has reached its final phase, and Heaven requires new sacrifices. And you and I—both are those final sacrifices.'

The rumbling outside the stone chamber grew closer, the aura of the demonic army already pressing against the entrance of the ruins. Chen Ji knew this was no time to linger. He cast one deep glance at the young man, imprinting every detail of his face into his memory. The chess game of fate had been revealed at a corner, and he, Chen Ji, would never consent to being a chess piece manipulated by others. The Heavenly Eye wanted him as a sacrifice? Then he would overturn the entire board!

choice.prompt: As the demonic army drew near and the mysterious young man seemed to know more truths, Chen Ji had to make a choice within the limited time—

choices.text: Take the mysterious young man and retreat together

text.content: Chen Ji grabbed the young man's wrist, his voice cold: "Come with me!" The young man paused momentarily, then revealed a relieved smile: "Brother is still that brother... Very well, I'll follow you. However—" his tone shifted, a cunning glint flashing in his eyes, "I have one condition. Bring me to Su Qingyao, and I can make her trust you completely."

choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to learn the truth

text.content: Chen Ji released his hand, stepping back, and took out a jade talisman from his chest, crushing it. The talisman transformed into a stream of light that entered the young man's brow center. "This is my tracking talisman; if I need you in the future, I will find you." The moment his words fell, a earth-shaking roar came from the stone chamber entrance—a massive beast shrouded in black energy had broken through the final seal!

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, grabbing the young man's neck and pinning him against the coffin: "Speak! What connection do you have with Su Qingyao? What exactly is the Heavenly Eye's chess game?" The young man showed no fear; instead, an eerie smile spread across his face: "So impatient, Brother? Su Qingyao... she is the 'eye' the Heavenly Eye left beside me, specifically to monitor whether I would betray. And now— she has fallen for you, which for heaven, is a great taboo."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Su Qingyao was the Heavenly Eye's eye? This was impossible! She was precisely the person most likely among the three major sects to see through his disguise, also an important variable in his plans. But the young man's words were like a thorn, piercing the softest part of his heart— had he fallen for Su Qingyao? This question, he had never seriously considered, or rather, had been deliberately avoiding.

At this moment, the second level stone chamber of the ruins collapsed with a thunderous roar. The massive beast shrouded in black energy had rushed to the front. Its body was as enormous as a mountain, a pair of crimson eyes staring fixedly at Chen Ji and the young man, emitting a deafening roar. "Demonic Path vanguard beast!" The young man's face changed drastically, "It was attracted by my aura— Brother, run! I'll hold it off!"

Chen Ji looked at the young man's resolute expression, his mind racing. Friend or foe, he could not yet determine. But the aura emanating from him, originating from the same source as the Tianji Record, gave him an inexplicable sense of familiarity. The gears of destiny had already begun to turn; whether he wished it or not, this "brother" who looked exactly like him had become an existence he could not avoid. The Heavenly Eye's chess game—he would overturn it with his own hands!

Just as Chen Ji's fingers were about to touch that mysterious existence, the corpse that had slumbered for ten thousand years in the coffin suddenly opened its eyes, and a surge of Heavenly Secrets aura from the same source as the Tianji Record rushed out like a tide—
